title: Traffic Statistics & Billing Chain (Exporter → Vector → Billing → PG → Accounts)
description: End-to-end traffic accounting and billing observability across Xray Exporter snapshot collection/push, Vector snapshot fan-out, Billing ingest pipeline stages (parse/checkpoint/dedup/bucket_write/quota), PostgreSQL persistence, and Accounts usage/billing query spans.

panels.title: 1 · Xray Up & Exporter Snapshot Freshness / Samples
panels.description: Xray process reachability (xray_up), snapshot collection age (seconds since xray_snapshot_last_collected_timestamp_seconds), push mode status, and active sample count.

panels.title: 2 · Exporter Collection & Push Outcomes
panels.description: Snapshot collection rate by outcome (success, empty, error) and HTTP push rate by status_class (2xx, 4xx, 5xx, transport_error).

panels.title: 3 · Vector Snapshot Fan-Out (Received / Sent / Errors / Buffer)
panels.description: Vector xray_snapshot_input and billing_snapshot_ingest event throughput, component errors, and buffered events.

panels.title: 4 · Billing Ingest Pipeline Stage Calls & Outcomes
panels.description: OTel spanmetrics call rate across billing.ingest.request, billing.ingest.checkpoint, billing.ingest.dedup, billing.ingest.bucket_write, and billing.ingest.quota by stage, outcome, error_class, and transport.

targets.expr: sum by (span_name, stage, outcome, transport) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{env=~"$env", service_name="web-saas-billing", span_name=~"billing\\.ingest\\..*", stage=~"$stage|^$", outcome=~"$outcome|^$", transport=~"$transport|^$"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (span_name, error_class) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{env=~"$env", service_name="web-saas-billing", span_name=~"billing\\.ingest\\..*", error_class!=""}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: 5 · Billing Ingest Pipeline Stage Duration (p50 / p95 / p99)
panels.description: Stage-by-stage latency distribution (ms) for web-saas-billing ingest spans.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.50, sum by (le, stage, span_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{env=~"$env", service_name="web-saas-billing", span_name=~"billing\\.ingest\\..*", stage=~"$stage|^$"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, stage, span_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{env=~"$env", service_name="web-saas-billing", span_name=~"billing\\.ingest\\..*", stage=~"$stage|^$"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le, stage, span_name) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{env=~"$env", service_name="web-saas-billing", span_name=~"billing\\.ingest\\..*", stage=~"$stage|^$"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: 6 · Accounts Usage & Billing Query Latency & Error Rate
panels.description: Accounts usage/billing endpoint and store query rate, error rate, and p95 duration.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, span_name, stage) (rate(traces_span_metrics_duration_milliseconds_bucket{env=~"$env", service_name="web-saas-accounts", span_name=~"GET /api/account/(usage|billing)/.*|accounts\\.(usage|billing)\\..*"}[$__rate_interval])))

sum by (span_name, outcome, status_code) (rate(traces_span_metrics_calls_total{env=~"$env", service_name="web-saas-accounts", span_name=~"GET /api/account/(usage|billing)/.*|accounts\\.(usage|billing)\\..*"}[$__rate_interval]))

options.content:
### Traffic Accounting & Billing Chain — Log / Trace Correlation Guide

1. **Zero-Traffic Alive vs Broken Pipeline**:
   - **Zero-Traffic Alive (`outcome="empty"` / `outcome="delta_zero"`)**: `xray_up == 1`, `time() - xray_snapshot_last_collected_timestamp_seconds < 120`, and `billing.ingest.dedup` records `outcome="empty"` or `outcome="delta_zero"`. The collection and ingestion chain is healthy while user traffic is idle.
   - **Broken Pipeline**: `xray_up == 0`, snapshot age `> 120s`, `xray_snapshot_push_total{status_class=~"5xx|transport_error"} > 0`, Vector `component_errors_total > 0`, or `billing.ingest.*` spans emit `outcome="error"`.
2. **Pivoting to VictoriaTraces & VictoriaLogs without PII**:
   - High-cardinality correlation keys (`snapshot_ref`, `batch_ref`, `trace_id`) are attached to **OTel Spans and Structured Logs only** and are never promoted to Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics labels.
   - Sensitive attributes (`user.email`, `account.uuid`, `proxy.uuid`, `db.statement`, `http.request.header.authorization`, `http.request.header.x_service_token`) are scrubbed at both the SDK and Collector layers.
   - In **VictoriaTraces / VictoriaLogs Explore**, filter by `env`, `service.name="web-saas-billing"`, `transport`, `stage`, `snapshot_ref`, or `trace_id` to inspect a specific snapshot batch end-to-end.
3. **Cross-Chain Drill-Down**:
   - Use the top-right **[Network Latency Chain](/grafana/d/dual-link-network-latency/network-latency-chain)** link to correlate ingest or query slowdowns with Blackbox RTT, DNS/TLS handshakes, Edge Caddy `/split` latency, or PostgreSQL `sql.conn.query` spans.
